dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent, and I'm here to help you understand what's been happening. Can you tell me if these voices you've been hearing only occur when you are feeling sad, or do they happen even when your mood feels okay?

The voices started months before I began feeling this deep sadness, so they happen even when my mood is okay. They mostly just mock me or tell me how worthless I am, no matter how I'm feeling that day. It's been going on for about seven months now.

I see, thank you for clarifying that timeline. How long has this period of deep sadness lasted so far, and have you noticed any other unusual experiences, like feeling like people are watching you or plotting against you?

The sadness has been weighing on me constantly for about four months now. I don't really feel like people are plotting against me, but I do get distracted because I'm always listening to those voices or staring off into space. I just feel so empty and it's getting harder to even focus on my work.

That sounds very difficult to manage. Have you been using any drugs, alcohol, or new medications since these symptoms began, and have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—extremely energetic, talkative, or like you didn't need sleep?

I don't use any drugs or alcohol, and I'm not on any medications right now. I've never had a time where I felt energetic or hyper; if anything, I'm just exhausted and can't find the energy to eat or sleep properly.
I'm sorry to hear how much you're struggling with your energy and sleep. Do you have any family history of mental health conditions, and have you noticed any changes in your physical health, like

Not that I know of; my family doesn't really talk about those kinds of things. As for my physical health, I'm just tired all the time and I’ve lost my appetite, but nothing else feels physically wrong. It’s just this heaviness and the voices that won't leave me alone.
I appreciate you sharing that with me. Given the nature of these voices and how heavy this sadness feels, have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life?

I’ve felt so empty and worthless lately that the thought has crossed my mind, but I haven't tried to do anything. The voices keep telling me I’m nothing, and it’s just getting harder to fight that feeling every day. I just want the heaviness to go away.
I am very concerned about what you're telling me, and I want to make sure you stay safe. Please call or text the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 right now to

I appreciate your concern, but I'm just here to figure out why I'm feeling this way. My boyfriend was the one who insisted I come in because he's noticed how much I've been struggling to function. I just want to understand why these voices started so long ago and why this sadness won't lift.

I understand that finding answers is your priority right now, though I want to emphasize that your safety is my primary concern. To help rule out any underlying physical causes, REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_
